No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. All nine apparent-disc transit stages remain in three-by-three reading order: before, first contact, partial ingress, totality begins, mid-totality, totality ends, partial egress, last contact, after. Sun radius 10 mm and Moon radius 11 mm preserve the original 10:11 apparent-radius ratio. Hidden solar contours remain omitted. The three totality stages intentionally have the same occulted appearance. Scene whitespace is re-laid out; only the first and last detached Moon offsets are increased by 0.5 mm for a 3.1 mm clear gap. Exact timing and physical distances are not encoded.", "canvas_mm": [170, 180]}, "teaching": "All nine apparent-disc transit stages remain in three-by-three reading order: before, first contact, partial ingress, totality begins, mid-totality, totality ends, partial egress, last contact, after. Sun radius 10 mm and Moon radius 11 mm preserve the original 10:11 apparent-radius ratio. Hidden solar contours remain omitted. The three totality stages intentionally have the same occulted appearance. Scene whitespace is re-laid out; only the first and last detached Moon offsets are increased by 0.5 mm for a 3.1 mm clear gap. Exact timing and physical distances are not encoded. This is an observer-view sequence, not the physical size/distance model in the separate alignment diagram.
